mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.xuanpai_name as xuanpaiName ,a.xuanpai_types as xuanpaiTypes ,a.zhuangtai_types as zhuangtaiTypes ,a.insert_time as insertTime ,a.create_time as createTime ,a.yuyue_user_id as yuyueUserId ,a.yuyue_expire_time as yuyueExpireTime ,a.version as version
mapper.select:
SELECT
-- 级联表的字段
FROM xuanpai a
and a.xuanpai_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.xuanpaiName},'%')
and a.xuanpai_types = #{params.xuanpaiTypes}
and a.zhuangtai_types = #{params.zhuangtaiTypes}
and UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.insert_time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{params.insertTimeStart})
and UNIX_TIMESTAMP(a.insert_time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{params.insertTimeEnd})
order by a.${params.orderBy} desc
mapper.update: UPDATE xuanpai SET zhuangtai_types = #{zhuangtaiTypes}, yuyue_user_id = #{yuyueUserId}, yuyue_expire_time = #{yuyueExpireTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND zhuangtai_types = 1 AND version = #{oldVersion}
